unit_label: BRBL C U01: Integrated Ombudsman Scheme 2021 (30 June 2026 snapshot) — Distinguish scrutiny, information requisitions and qualified confidentiality

facts.locator: printed pp.228; PDF page = printed page + 19
facts.statement: Courseware outlines initial scrutiny and the information process; its prose calls the information power clause14 whereas the scheme heading is clause13.

Filing information/signature rules and scrutiny distinguish suggestions/guidance, non-maintainable and remaining complaints. Clause13 permits specified information/certified-document requisition and qualified inference on unjustified noncompliance. Confidentiality has law/consent, inter-party natural-justice and RBI/court/forum/authority qualifications.

payload.title: Initial scrutiny sorts the kind of submission
payload.core_explanation_md:
Under the 2021 scheme, a suggestion or request for general guidance is not treated as a valid complaint merely because it reaches the complaint channel. Clause 12 separately addresses non-maintainable complaints and the remaining complaints assigned for further examination. A copy goes to the regulated entity with a direction to submit its version.

This is a sorting and examination process, not a presumption that either side is correct. Retain the submitted complaint, required information and receipt record. The physical-signature and specified-format conditions in clause 11 are part of the filing enquiry; an acknowledgement does not cure every missing requirement.

self_check.prompt_text: Why should a general request for guidance be separated from a complaint alleging a service shortcoming?
self_check.expected_takeaway: The scheme initial scrutiny treats these as different kinds of submission.

payload.title: Confidentiality does not prevent the stated fair-process disclosures
payload.core_explanation_md:
Clause 13 permits the Ombudsman to request the specified information or certified documents from the relevant regulated entity. Unjustified failure to comply can support the stated inference; it should not be relabelled as a harmless administrative choice.

The same clause protects information but includes qualifications. Relevant inter-party disclosure for natural justice, legal requirements, consent and the specified RBI or forum disclosures must be read with the confidentiality rule. A bank should not assert either absolute secrecy against every requisition or unrestricted public disclosure of the complaint file. This draft concerns the defined scheme process, not permission to share customer data outside it.

self_check.prompt_text: Does confidentiality necessarily permit a regulated entity to refuse every Ombudsman information request?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The requisition power and the qualified confidentiality provisions must be read together.

payload.stem_md: A bank invokes absolute confidentiality to refuse every clause13 document request, without identifying a lawful ground or reading the provision. Which distinction is needed?

options.text_md: Confidentiality allows every party to publish the complete customer file
options.explanation_md: The clause protects information and permits defined qualifications, not unrestricted publication.

options.text_md: The statutory information power and qualified confidentiality rule coexist
options.explanation_md: The bank cannot replace them with a universal refusal rule.

options.text_md: An information request proves the bank must lose the complaint
options.explanation_md: A request is an evidence step, not a final merits conclusion.

options.text_md: A customer data label automatically removes every fair-process disclosure
options.explanation_md: The clause expressly recognises relevant natural-justice and other stated disclosures.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The bank cannot replace them with a universal refusal rule.

payload.stem_md: A submission asks only for general financial guidance and alleges no service deficiency. It is processed as a proved complaint solely because the portal accepted it. Which stage has been overlooked?

options.text_md: Only the online or physical submission route decides whether a guidance request is maintainable
options.explanation_md: The route does not replace the initial scrutiny of what the submission actually alleges or requests.

options.text_md: The fact that all portal submissions must produce an award
options.explanation_md: The scheme distinguishes suggestions/guidance from valid complaints.

options.text_md: Only the disputed amount matters to whether a submission alleges a deficiency
options.explanation_md: Amount alone does not supply the missing grievance allegation.

options.text_md: Clause12 initial scrutiny and its treatment of guidance/suggestion submissions
options.explanation_md: Portal receipt is not the same as substantive complaint classification.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Portal receipt is not the same as substantive complaint classification.
